name: ViewRank Post View Rankings
author: ikedajapan

sections.description:
ViewRank Post View Rankings is a lightweight WordPress plugin that tracks page views and displays popular posts based on page views.

It also provides random post display, widgets, shortcodes, thumbnail display, category display, and customizable display settings.

Features

  • Popular post ranking
  • Random posts
  • Today, 7 days, 30 days, and all-time rankings
  • Shortcode support
  • Widget support
  • Thumbnail display
  • Category display
  • Japanese and English language support
  • Option to exclude administrator page views
  • Customizer settings

Shortcodes

[spp_random_posts]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings as needed.
